title: The students who ran the university

probes.question: What was the 'universitas scholarium' at Bologna?
True or false: Bologna is considered the oldest university in continuous operation in the world.

image.alt: A 14th-century miniature of a professor lecturing from a pulpit to rows of students in a medieval university hall at Bologna

body.question: Medieval Bologna became a university in the late 12th century. Who was it organised by?
body.reveal: Guilds of students. The university became organised as a universitas scholarium, a guild of students, by the late 12th century. Teaching began around 1088, and Bologna is regarded as the oldest university in continuous operation.
